description: OnePlus is gearing up to launch the Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite in India, following the debut of the Nord 6 earlier this month. It focuses less on expanding the horizons and more on delivering a balanced, no-frills experience at a competitive price point. With the Nord CE 6, however, OnePlus seems to be narrowing that gap between its CE and the more premium Nord models. Based on our first look, the OnePlus Nord CE 6 appears more refined and cohesive within the broader Nord family than previous generations.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Hands-On

description: WhatsApp may be working on extending its Liquid Glass design to the chat interface on iOS, bringing a more modern look with translucent elements and layered visuals. According to a report, the update could redesign the chat bar and navigation bar, introducing a floating layout and transparent effects. The feature is still under development and not available for testing yet. Liquid Glass has only partially rolled out so far, and WhatsApp appears to be refining performance before expanding the update to more users.
title: WhatsApp Could Soon Begin Testing Redesigned Liquid Glass UI for Chats on iOS: Report

description: Huawei Nova 15 series arrived in December last year, featuring the Nova 15 Ultra, Nova 15 Pro, and Nova 15 models. Now, it looks like the next generation of Huawei Nova 16 series smartphones is on the way. Huawei is yet to confirm this officially, but ahead of it, a new leak has suggested that the new lineup will include Nova 16, Nova 16 Pro, and Nova 16 Pro Max variants, skipping the Ultra variant. The leak also offers details about their possible colour options.
title: Huawei Nova 16 Series Leak Reveals Colour Options; Huawei Nova 16 Pro Max Model Expected to Debut

title: Falcon 9 Launches 45 Satellites in Major Global Rideshare Mission

description: Oppo Reno 16 Pro and Oppo Reno 16F spotted on multiple global certification platforms, including TDRA, NBTC, EEC, and TÜV Rheinland. These listings confirm model numbers, 5G connectivity and up to 80W fast charging. The Reno 16 Pro will launch in China later this month. It is expected to come with a 6.78-inch 1.5K LTPO OLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It could run on a MediaTek Dimensity chipset and feature a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Oppo Reno 16 Pro Bags Multiple Certifications Including TDRA, TÜV Rheinland; Reno 16F Gets NBTC Nod

description: Google may be testing a redesign for its Gemini app, as early screenshots shared on Reddit suggest a more dynamic interface. The update appears to bring animated backgrounds, a cleaner layout, and a unified menu for tools. The redesign has only been spotted on iOS so far and does not seem widely available yet. Reports indicate that Gemini could become more responsive and easier to use, but Android users may have to wait longer as the rollout appears to be limited and still under testing.
title: Gemini App Reportedly Gets Extensive UI Redesign on iOS With New Animated Interface

description: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) will be launched in China on May 19 with an octa core Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset from Qualcomm, which is built on a 3nm process, the company has confirmed. The gaming smartphone will also be equipped with a vapour chamber cooling solution to avoid overheating and throttling, featuring a 5,500 sq mm heat dissipation area, offering 12W liquid metal thermal conductivity and 10W “high thermal conductivity gel” (translated from Chinese). The upcoming handset is confirmed to be backed by an 8,000mAh “Star Ring” battery.
title: Lenovo Legion Y70 (2026) Chipset, Battery Capacity and Other Key Specifications Confirmed Weeks Ahead of Debut

description: Capital B has secured $1.28 million from Blockstream CEO Adam Back through a warrant issuance. The funding will be used to accelerate the company’s Bitcoin treasury strategy as firms continue exploring different approaches to managing digital asset exposure.
title: Capital B Secures $1.3 Million From Adam Back for Bitcoin-Focused Strategy

description: Itel Power 80 has been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number P685L, according to a report. The handset has been listed on the benchmarking platform with an octa core Spreadtrum UMS9230E SoC, which is said to be the Unisoc T7250 chipset. The rumoured Itel Power 80 is shown to feature six efficiency cores clocked at 1.61GHz and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 1.82GHz. Moreover, it is expected to ship with Android 16 and 4GB of RAM.
title: Itel Power 80 Geekbench Listing Reportedly Reveals Key Specifications, Features

description: A potential deal between GameStop and eBay would upend the usual M&A playbook, as it is rare for a company to target one nearly four times its size. Such deals typically rely on substantial debt, stock issuance, or both - banking on future earnings of the combined company to justify the cost.
title: GameStop Makes Bold $56 Billion Play for eBay, Ready to Go Hostile

description: OnePlus Ace 7 has appeared in early leaks, suggesting major performance upgrades ahead of its expected Q4 2026 launch. According to a tipster, the phone could feature the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset along with a built-in active cooling system for better sustained performance. Another tipster also hints at an ultra-high refresh rate display, possibly approaching 240Hz. These upgrades indicate a strong focus on gaming and efficiency, building on the OnePlus Ace 6’s high-performance hardware and large battery setup.
title: OnePlus Ace 7 Leak Suggests Gamers Can Expect Flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 Chipset, Active Cooling

description: Bungie has said that it has plans for Marathon's story for the "next few years," suggesting it intends to support the game long term. “We know where we want to take the story over the next few years, but I don't want to say it’s completely 'locked in' because it's important to us that our players be able to help shape it,” Marathon creative director Julia Nardin said in an interview.
title: Bungie Says It Has Plans for Marathon Story for 'Next Few Years'

description: ChatGPT’s conversations with the alleged mass shooter, Phoenix Ikner, have reportedly surfaced, revealing concerning details. Ikner, who is currently in custody and has been charged with the mass shooting at Florida State University (FSU) in the US, reportedly asked ChatGPT for critical information about handling a handgun and the number of deaths it would take to get the incident national coverage moments before allegedly killing and injuring multiple students.
title: ChatGPT Allegedly Helped Student Plan Mass Shooting at FSU Last Year: Report

description: Valve announced the expansion of its gaming hardware lineup with the launch of the new Steam Controller on Monday. The company claims it is designed to work seamlessly across devices running Steam. The controller is compatible with PCs, laptops, smartphones, tablets, and even the Steam Deck, positioning it as a versatile accessory for gamers across platforms. It comes with magnetic thumbsticks with TMR (Tunnel MagnetoResistance) for improved responsiveness and durability, while a combination of high-definition rumble and grip-enabled gyro, enables gyro with capacitive touch.
title: Valve Steam Controller Launched With TMR-Supported Magentic Thumbsticks, Grip Sense Support: Price, Specifications

description: The Academy Awards, better known as the Oscars, are tightening the rules for artificial intelligence (AI). New rules, released on Friday, specifically highlight that AI actors or screenplays written using an AI tool will not be eligible to be nominated or win the award starting next year. Additionally, the organisation behind the Oscars can also request more information from filmmakers about the usage of the technology and human authorship.
title: Oscars Revise Eligibility Rules, Ban AI Actors and Scripts From Winning Awards

description: YouTube is causing widespread browser slowdowns due to a suspected interface bug that triggers an endless layout loop. Users across Firefox, Brave, and Edge report heavy lag, stuttering, and RAM usage exceeding 7GB in some cases. According to a report, the issue lies in YouTube’s flexible menu below the video player. The interface repeatedly hides and restores buttons, forcing constant layout recalculations. This loop consumes CPU and memory, leading to freezing tabs. Mozilla is investigating, but no fix has been confirmed yet.
title: YouTube Bug Reportedly Freezes Browser Tabs, Increases CPU and Memory Usage

description: Apple is expected to employ an "aggressive pricing strategy" for its rumoured iPhone 18 Pro Max and iPhone 18 Pro models, according to a research note from market analyst Jeff Pu seen by 9to5Mac. This hints that the Cupertino-based tech giant could either keep the prices of the two smartphones unchanged from their predecessors or increase their prices marginally. The analyst also predicts that the market share of Android smartphones could decrease, as the difference between the prices of iPhone models and premium Android handsets will not be as stark.
title: iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro Max Said to Launch With ‘Aggressive' Pricing as Component Prices Continue to Rise
